text:
Marta (secops): Heads-up — security advisory: telemetry-sdk < 2.4.1 can exfiltrate AWS instance metadata when run as a sidecar or with permissive network namespaces. We observed outbound calls to 169.254.169.254 from staging pods in the last 24h. Treat as P1, immediate actions required.

Kevin (infra): ack — can you paste the repro / indicators?

Marta (secops): repro snippet (staging):
```
$ kubectl -n staging logs monitoring-agent-7f89c -c agent | tail -n 30
INFO sending telemetry to telemetry.example.com:443
DEBUG curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
```
Outbound host appears as telemetry.example.com (third-party vendor).

Jamie (platform SRE): running cluster-scan across environments now. Will spin up a K8s Job to detect image tags <2.4.1 and grep logs for 169.254.169.254. ETA ~25m.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1942 — telemetry-agent-metadata-exfil. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1942

Kevin (infra): Proposed mitigations:
1) Apply egress deny for telemetry.example.com at the VPC/NSG level in prod & staging.
2) Roll forward monitoring-agent -> 2.4.1 (vendor patch).
3) Scan for IAM/instance-role access and rotate any creds if we detect exposure.

Alex (privacy): Quick question — are customer-dedicated clusters affected? If they run the same agent, yes. We should separate host-managed vs customer-managed in the notification.

Olivia (legal): Please don't send external customer notices until we have the incident scope and affected list. I'll prepare a template but hold distribution.

Marta (secops): Action items (owner - SLA):
- infra: apply egress block for telemetry.example.com in prod & staging within 2h (SLA 1h for staging)
- platform: roll monitoring-agent -> 2.4.1 across clusters (rolling, 20% batches) within 4h
- secops: run scans for 169.254.169.254 hits and compile impacted pods + service accounts within 2h
- infra/secops: rotate any IAM credentials discovered and notify CS/Legal for customers if needed
Reply in-thread with confirmations.

Kevin (infra): Applying egress rule to staging now. Command we used: 
```
az network nsg rule create --resource-group rg-staging --nsg-name nsg-staging --name deny-telemetry --priority 100 --access Deny --direction Outbound --destination-address-prefixes telemetry.example.com --destination-port-ranges 443
```
Posting rule diff in a sec.

Jamie (platform SRE): K8s rollout job kicked off (rolling 20% batches). I'll post rollout status.

Marta (secops): Useful indicator queries:
- GCP logs: `gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.request.uri:"169.254.169.254"' --limit 100`
- K8s: `kubectl logs -n monitoring -l app=monitor -c agent | grep 169.254.169.254`
- Egress: check outbound connections to telemetry.example.com in VPC flow logs.

Kevin (infra): Rule applied in staging: nsg/deny-telemetry id=/subscriptions/.../nsgs/nsg-staging/rules/deny-telemetry :thumbsup:

Jamie (platform SRE): Rollout at 30% now, no crashes so far. Will pause on failures and revert if needed.

Marta (secops): If you find pods with exfil traces, quarantine (kubectl cordon && kubectl delete pod) and capture logs + images. Preserve artifacts in /shared/secops/incidents/INC-1942. DM me for any creds you find.

Alex (privacy): Looping DPO and preparing internal notice for EU customers in case we need to notify regulators.

Olivia (legal): Draft notice ready, will wait for affected-customer list.

Marta (secops): Triage call at 15:30 UTC in #incidents — infra, platform, legal, privacy, CS required.

Kevin (infra): oncall notified: @oncall-infra

Jamie (platform SRE): referencing runbook: runbook/agent-telemetry-exfil.md — proceeding against checklist.

sec-bot: Reminder: initial response SLA 1h. Current elapsed: 18m.

Marta (secops): Quick status: staging egress blocked, patch rollout in progress, scanning ongoing. Will post follow-ups and summary after triage. Final postmortem to follow. Thank you everyone.
